verdict.rationale: Attio's own marketing describes native in-product AI that produces insights and suggestions from workspace data. 'Ask Attio' lets users search, update and create with AI and pull live data from pipeline conversations. AI also picks up buying signals and blockers on calls, drafts account briefs and follow-ups, flags coaching moments, scores leads against ICP criteria, and surfaces next-best customers. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how Ask Attio and the insight features work (scope, data coverage, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as marketed.
